subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Smishing and Vishing
description: A 60-second lesson on Smishing and Vishing.

hook.text: A text from your delivery service says a package is held up. Click here to confirm your address.

buildup.text: Smishing uses SMS texts. Vishing uses voice calls. Both apply phishing psychology to other channels.

discovery.text: People trust texts more than emails. Smishing click rates are eight times higher than email phishing.

twist.text: Voice AI now generates real-time conversations. Vishing calls can sound perfectly human.

climax.text: Phishing has expanded beyond email into every communication channel you use.

punchline.text: If they can reach you, they can phish you.

quiz.question: Why are smishing attacks more effective than email phishing?
options: People trust texts more — click rates are 8x higher
